name: Home Area Reporter
shortDescription: Explore Seattle neighborhood plans, permits and local context from a Redfin or Zillow listing.
description:
See beyond the listing before choosing a home or business location.

Home Area Reporter reads the ZIP from a Redfin or Zillow listing when you open the extension, then shows current Seattle permit highlights and links to a fuller neighborhood report.

Explore housing plans, building-height mentions, retail and commercial-use work, on-site parking proposals, and potential demolition or site work. The website also includes selected local employers, groceries, transit and medical facilities, a Metro bus-route overlay, and reviewed parks/public-improvement highlights where available.

Choose a home or commercial view and open official project examples. Share the listing location only if you want location-based ordering.

Coverage: reviewed Seattle ZIPs are enabled after complete ingestion and neighborhood checks. Shared ZIPs include Seattle municipal records only; the website reports current availability. proposals and permits do not confirm construction, business openings or completion. This is an early release, not a property valuation or a prediction of prices, rents, safety or investment returns.

The current report is free. Paid reports are not available. Soundscore is an optional website integration and does not show real scores until its provider connection is configured.

Independent product; not affiliated with Redfin, Zillow or the City of Seattle.
singlePurpose: Help users research documented neighborhood changes for a supported Seattle ZIP while viewing a Redfin or Zillow listing.

permissionJustifications.activeTab: Read the current listing URL and listing context only after the user opens the extension; used to validate the site and identify a supported ZIP.
permissionJustifications.scripting: Run packaged extraction code on the user-invoked listing tab to read JSON-LD and find the ZIP; website content remains local except the disclosed ZIP and optional listing context.
permissionJustifications.storage: Store only the reporter website origin in local Chrome storage; no browsing history, listing address or coordinates are stored.
permissionJustifications.hostPermissions: Call the single production reporter origin and embed its map. The release package requests no localhost, broad website or background browsing access.

privacyDisclosures.websiteContent: Listing JSON-LD/title/text is processed locally to identify ZIP, address and coordinates.
privacyDisclosures.location: The selected ZIP is sent to the reporter backend. Listing coordinates and the report address are shared only when the user opts into listing location.
privacyDisclosures.browsingActivity: The active tab URL is checked locally to validate Redfin/Zillow; it is not sent to the backend. No browsing history or other tabs are read.
privacyDisclosures.remoteCode: All extension-context JavaScript is packaged locally. The popup embeds the production website /map in a cross-origin iframe, isolated from extension APIs. That website context loads its own map code; no server response is evaluated in the extension context. Declare this iframe in the dashboard remote-code justification.

dataDisclosureScope: Listing address and coordinates, selected ZIP, and local processing of current-tab URL/title/text. No browsing-history API, other-tab access, or listing-URL transmission. Address/coordinates are sent only after location opt-in.
reviewerInstructions: Open a Redfin or Zillow listing in a supported ZIP and invoke the extension. Confirm or enter 98103, then choose Check this area. Verify summary highlights, map and Open full report. Listing-location sharing is optional and defaults off. No product login or payment is required. Provider availability can cause a partial permit response; unsupported ZIPs are explicitly rejected.
